topic: PostgreSQL logical replication and change feeds
title: PostgreSQL logical replication and change feeds
brief: Treat PostgreSQL logical replication as a selective row stream with its own identity and lifecycle.
outcomes: Configure publication and subscriber with explicit replica identity
Account for schema, sequence, lag and cutover responsibilities
entry: General replicas and PostgreSQL physical replication distinctions.

heading.title: A row stream
heading.brief: Select a shop table for publication and initial copy; distinguish logical decoding, subscription application and an application-level event contract.

heading.title: Identity and conflicts
heading.brief: Update and delete replicated rows under a stated replica identity; keep independent subscriber writes outside the happy path and inspect conflicts.

heading.title: What does not travel
heading.brief: Expose DDL, sequences and other documented omissions with a concrete failed continuation; coordinate schema compatibility explicitly.

heading.title: Lag and lifecycle
heading.brief: Observe slot retention and subscriber progress, recover a failed subscriber and fence writes for cutover; do not infer exactly-once external effects from row replication.
